### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct applicant starter | $1,000 | Deepgram's starter offer starts at $1,000 in free Startup Program credits, with opportunities to upgrade to tiers worth up to $100,000 as you grow and deepen your product usage. | No partner needed |
| Partner-referred offer | — | Deepgram has active partnerships with leading venture capital firms, accelerators, and startup networks that provide enhanced offers to their portfolios. | A partner improves the offer, but is not required |

### Not covered

- agencies or consultants building on behalf of clients

> **Stacking:** Applying through a VC/accelerator partner replaces the direct-applicant offer with that partner's listed offer.

### Notes

Vendor self-contradiction: the hero states 'up to $100,000 in credits over 12 months', while the FAQ says direct applicants start at $1,000 with upgrade tiers up to $100,000. The more conservative FAQ figure is recorded in tiers[]. No funding cap is stated as a hard rule; the FAQ only says applications above $10M raised are reviewed case-by-case.
